Question: Which completed work orders lasted more than 7 days from schedule to completion?

missing_value_hints: work_orders.status = 'completed' OR work_orders.completed_date IS NOT NULL
rank_trace.sql:
SELECT w.work_order_id, w.status, w.scheduled_date  
   FROM work_orders w  
   WHERE w.status = 'completed'  
     AND (julianday(w.completed_date) - julianday(w.scheduled_date)) > 7  
   ORDER BY w.work_order_id;
